title: Waver
description: UI element component that applies a wave animation effect.
content:
Waver

UI element component that applies a sinusoidal wave animation effect for rhythmic motion.

Component UI

Schema

JSON
"waver": {
  "amplitude": 0.0,
  "frequency": 0.0
}

Description

The Waver component applies a smooth, sinusoidal wave animation to a UI element. It creates a rhythmic oscillating motion defined by amplitude and frequency, commonly used for hover effects, pulsing indicators, bobbing icons, and attention-drawing animations. The wave motion follows a sine curve for natural-looking movement.

Fields

NameTypeDescription
amplitudefloatThe maximum displacement of the wave in pixels.
frequencyfloatThe number of complete wave cycles per second.

Example

JSON
{
  "components": {
    "waver": {
      "amplitude": 8.0,
      "frequency": 1.5
    }
  }
}
